headlines.headline: Kansas's Bill Self returns for 2026-27 season after health scare
headlines.detail: The 63-year-old Self, hospitalized earlier this year for an AFib episode, confirmed he'll coach Kansas again despite contemplating retirement.

headlines.headline: Draymond Green re-signs with Warriors on one-year, $27.7M deal
headlines.detail: Golden State brought Green back as it retools around Stephen Curry. Blazers guard Shaedon Sharpe reportedly suffered a torn meniscus.

headlines.headline: NFL teams race to cut rosters to 53 before Sunday's deadline
headlines.detail: All 32 teams must trim from 90 to 53 players by Sunday, Aug. 30 — roughly 1,184 players will lose their jobs.

headlines.headline: College football season opens with Week 0 FCS slate
headlines.detail: 13 FCS games kicked off the 2026 season Thursday. FBS play begins Saturday, headlined by North Carolina vs. TCU in Dublin, Ireland.
